segments.text:
First, In your receiving Christ beware you do not mistake
the means, for the end: many do so, but see you do not: Prayer, Sermons, Reformations are means to bring you to Christ, but they are not Christ: to close with those duties is one thing, and to close with Christ is another thing: if I go into a Boat, my design is not to dwell there, but to be carried to the place whereon I desire to be landed. So it must be in this case, all your Duties must land you upon Christ: they are but means to bring you to Christ.
